scope: Exclusive charged+charged+neutral three-pion contribution to the restricted weighted count, not inclusive hadrons. Independent SND and BABAR alternatives use caps equal to the quoted central values plus twice the error sums, not confidence intervals. SND carries an additional factor-three safety multiplier for the normalization printed in its Eq. (14). The optional low and high R=1 comparisons use disjoint windows, omit energy above 4 GeV, do not assert R=1 in those regions, and do not include other species or finite-temperature spectral changes.
